requirements.description: The candidate proves the full requested theorem, not only a definition or example.
The proved theorem applies to the requested algorithm and its output.
The result is connected to every occurrence in the original input.
The requested componentwise backward-error conclusion is proved.
The candidate does not assume, circularly encode, or vacuously imply the conclusion.

defect_categories.description: The requested proposition is defined or discussed but never proved.
A fixed example replaces the requested universal theorem.
The desired result, or an equivalent fact, is introduced as a hypothesis.
The mathematical bound is not connected to the implemented algorithm.
Returned leaves or perturbations are not connected to original input occurrences.
The candidate proves a weaker conclusion than the request.

construction_policy: Construct Algorithm 1 with offset pairing and unchanged carries, and deliver the full theorem on arbitrary nonempty original inputs and their occurrences.
